purpose: Reassure someone that an action is unnecessary.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
Verb dictionary form + ことはない
There is no need to hurry so much.
You do not need to be ashamed of failing.
It is still new, so there is no need to replace it.
formation: Verb dictionary form + ことはない
restrictions: Often offers advice about an unnecessary worry or response.
mistake: Do not confuse with たことがない, which denies experience.
